**Loot:** Volcano Manor

  - To reach it, the player must start from the Temple of Eiglay Site of Grace and take the elevator up to the upper level of the manor (where the Man-Serpent with Magma Blades patrol). Head northwest, past the Man-Serpent with the Magma Whip Candlestick, into the building and then rightwards into the throne room. Take either of the first sets of stairs up, followed by the second set of stairs that go away from the throne itself. Up on the second floor there will be a door that leads to another, locked by an Imp Statue. Unlock the statue and head through until a large room filled with hanging cages that can be used to descend downwards. Once the player has reached the bottom, they can head to the door opening on the northeastern wall of the room which will eventually lead to this item.
Once this item has been obtained, it can be duplicated by trading in Lost Ashes of War to Smithing Master Hewg.

rows.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
rows.location:
Found in a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo. The level can be accessed via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

From the Debate Parlor site of grace, go outside to the left until you meet two Raya Lucaria Sorcerers. Jump down on the stairs next to them. Continue forward until you can jump onto the rooftops. Then, proceed further and go up the ladder at the end of said rooftops.

After the sorcerer, go down on the rooftops again, until you can see a dome-like structure that has windows. Go through one of the windows, and descend onto the lower floor. One of the exits leads to a enclosed bridge, with a High Page guarding the secluded room. The staff is in the room behind him, in front of the inactive School of Graven Mages.
prereqs: After the sorcerer, go down on the rooftops again, until you can see a dome-like structure that has windows.

rows.location:

rows.name: Bolt of Gransax
rows.location:
Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Exit the Erdtree Sanctuary and descend with the elevator, then jump over the street railing and down onto the building below. The spear is on top of its gigantic version.

**Warning**: This item is not present in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. It must be obtained prior to defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
prereqs: It must be obtained prior to defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

rows.name: Boltdrake Talisman
rows.location:

rows.name: Boltdrake Talisman +1
rows.location:
**Loot:** Altus Plateau
- Acquired from a corpse within a wooden shed guarded by dogs in Old Altus Tunnel.

rows.name: Boltdrake Talisman +2
rows.location:
**Loot:** Crumbling Farum Azula
- Obtained from a corpse near the Dragon Temple Rooftop Site of Grace. From the Rooftop Grace proceed southeast to the arena of an Ancient Dragon. Proceed east to the edge of the arena, where you can drop to a series of platforms, leading to an isolated building. Proceed through the building, up a ladder, up an elevator, past a Crucible Knight, and up one more ladder, to find the corpse, hanging out of a window.
rows.near: Obtained from a corpse near the Dragon Temple Rooftop

rows.name: Boltdrake Talisman +3
rows.location:
- It can be found at Shadow Keep. From the Storehouse: First Floor site of grace, take the stairs up to the second floor and find a dead-end with several shade protectors. Jump over the railing to reach a room with the talisman, then use the lever to move the bookcase and re-emerge near the site of grace.

- Alternatively, From Storehouse, Back Section site of grace, immediately turn around and head east through the doorway, shortly after passing through the doorway, look to down to your left and there should be a large rectangular table that you can safely jump down to. The talisman should be right behind you on the floor next to that table.
prereqs: - Alternatively, From Storehouse, Back Section site of grace, immediately turn around and head east through the doorway, shortly after passing through the doorway, look to down to your left and there should be a large rectangular table that you can safely jump down to.

- The Brick Hammer is found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle in the area within the wall past the  Stormveil Cliffside site of grace. It is accessed by climbing the ladder behind the door unlocked by the Rusty Key and turning right to jump across the gap, crossing the beams, and then jumping to another platform leading to an opening in the wall. Follow the path outside and reenter at the round tower. The corpse hangs from a ledge.

  - Grave Keeper's Brainpan

- Lamenter's Gaol (x1): drop down the destructible path, exit the room, and ascend the stairs. Follow the path on the right to reach a small room containing a corpse holding Call of Tibia.

rows.name: Calm Down!
rows.location:
Quest Item: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Mt. Gelmir
- This gesture has multiple opportunities of acquisition:
  - Confronting Patches at Murkwater Cave after getting ensnared in his teleporter trap chest.
  - Confronting Patches by the Scenic Isle Site of Grace, after following his suggestion and getting killed by the Abductor Virgin at the bottom of the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
  - Confronting Patches by the cliffs west of the First Mt.Gelmir Campsite after getting kicked down to Seethewater River.
rows.near: Confronting Patches by the Scenic Isle
prereqs: - Confronting Patches at Murkwater Cave after getting ensnared in his teleporter trap chest.

- Confronting Patches by the cliffs west of the First Mt.Gelmir Campsite after getting kicked down to Seethewater River.

rows.name: Cannon of Haima
rows.location:
Converted Fringe Tower, north-east Liurnia of the Lakes, not to be mistaken with the Converted Tower in the south-west.

You will need to use the Erudition gesture given by Thops in front of the statue of Marika. This will reveal a hidden ladder to the top of the tower with a treasure chest that contains the spell.

Unlike with the Converted Tower, here you will not only have to do the gesture, but also wear a glintstone crown headpiece while doing so.

Head down here, and northeast again, to drop down to the lower level of the aqueduct. Continue to the end of the aqueduct, and drop down several levels of broken floor, to the bottom of the building below, where the corpse can be found.

Use the pile of sandbags to climb onto the wall, use it to reach the ledge of the attached tower, and jump over to a nearby tower, whose crown has been destroyed. Drop down into this tower, and then down onto a roof, next to a Warhawk. Head across a small connecting rooftop to the next building over, where a broken pillar lies leaning against a wall. Climb up this pillar, sneak around a ledge, and climb a ladder to reach the corpse.

rows.name: Crucible Feather Talisman
rows.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Auriza Hero's Grave in the Leyndell, Royal Capital region. Make your way to the area where two chariots ride side-by-side, up and down a slope. At the bottom of this slope is a corpse, hanging off of a ledge above a pit. Drop into the pit from where this corpse lies to land on a beam, and continue dropping down into this pit, until landing on the top of a thin stone archway. Walk to the end of this archway and climb a ladder to reach another ramp, guarded by a single chariot. While it is possible to reach the bottom of this ramp without dying, it is extremely difficult, as it involves either taking a hit from the chariot without dying, or using a movement ability, like Bloodhound Step, along with excellent timing. The far easier thing to do is to proceed up the ramp until reaching a moving, fire-breathing pillar, which can be raised by hitting it. After raising the pillar, die or teleport to return to the ramp with two chariots. The raised pillar will now be shining a chariot-spawning circle of light onto the middle of this ramp, which will cause a chariot to spawn that collides with the others, destroying them all. The door at the bottom of the ramp leading to the corpse can now be safely reached.
prereqs: After raising the pillar, die or teleport to return to the ramp with two chariots.

**Location**: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
- Obtained from a chest in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. From Drainage Channel, head east and travel along tree roots, branches, and buttresses to reach the roof of the nearby church, which is full of Pests. Drop through a hole in the roof, and head southwest along the rafters to reach an upper platform, with the chest.

rows.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman
rows.location: - Obtained from a corpse that lies on the ground, near Bestial Sanctum, in northern Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. Equipping the Longtail Cat Talisman here, or using Soft Cotton is very helpful, as there are several parkour drops coming up that will deal unavoidable damage, and there are Bat enemies in the area. From the front door of the sanctum, head southwest around the side of the sanctum, until reaching a cliff that overlooks a large tree root, close enough to drop to. Drop from here to the branch, to another branch, to a domed rooftop, and then to the first of 3 ring structures, jutting out from the cliffside. Jump up to the ledge surrounding the nearby pillar, walk across the buttress to the next pillar, drop to the lower ledge, jump to another lower ledge on the first pillar, and drop down to the second ring. Jump to the next-lower ledge on the outer pillar, walk across the buttress, and jump to a ledge that sticks out from the wall below. At this point, it is recommended to mount Torrent, as the final jump is extremely difficult to make on foot, while almost trivial to make with Torrent's double-jump ability. The third ring below is just barely beyond the instant-death threshold for falling, so instead, aim for the ledge on that outer pillar, just a few feet above the ring. After finally reaching the third ring, head northeast along it to find the corpse.
prereqs: After finally reaching the third ring, head northeast along it to find the corpse.

rows.name: Dragoncrest Shield Talisman +1

Follow this path to reach a room that has a pair of semi-transparent fog walls, locked by an imp statue that requires one Stonesword Key to open. The corpse can be found past this wall.
prereqs: Follow this path to reach a room that has a pair of semi-transparent fog walls, locked by an imp statue that requires one Stonesword Key to open.

Halfway across this debris, after a somewhat large drop, turn around to see a hidden floating chunk of rubble, holding the corpse.
  - Starting from Dragon Temple Lift, if unlocked, turn around to go down the elevator, and arrive near the beginning of the long chain of debris.
prereqs: Halfway across this debris, after a somewhat large drop, turn around to see a hidden floating chunk of rubble, holding the corpse.

rows.name: Erdtree's Favor
rows.location: - Obtained from an altar in Fringefolk Hero's Grave, in western Limgrave. This dungeon is accessed from Stranded Graveyard after inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the nearby imp statue, to unlock the semi-transparent fog wall. Proceed down the ladder and across the poison pond, to reach a ramp, patrolled by an invincible chariot. Proceed down the ramp by hiding in alcoves on the side, to avoid the chariot. When the ramp turns into a bridge, with gaps on either side, drop from either side of the highest point of the bridge, to reach a lower platform. Proceed to a stairway, but beware of the fire trap at its bottom. Fire a projectile at the pillar at the end of the hallway to disable it. Proceed down the hallway to a large room, with a bridge across the middle, to reach the altar on the other side. Beware of two Grafted Scions that will fall from the ceiling as you traverse the bridge.
prereqs: This dungeon is accessed from Stranded Graveyard after inserting 2 Stonesword Keys into the nearby imp statue, to unlock the semi-transparent fog wall.

rows.name: Erdtree's Favor +2
rows.location: - Obtained from a corpse in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, which can only be accessed late-game, after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade. This area is only accessible when approaching from the Forbidden Lands. Head west into the capital from the Grand Lift of Rold, down the staircases, and to the south end of the ash-covered area, where the corpse can be found, hanging from the top of a tree root that juts out of the ground. Beware of the three Ulcerated Tree Spirits that guard the area. Hug the walls of the area as you head south to avoid them.
prereqs: - Obtained from a corpse in Leyndell, Ashen Capital, which can only be accessed late-game, after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

- The locked Nox treasure chest containing the Fingerslayer Blade only opens for Ranni's followers. "**You are not destined to open this**" displays if the player tries to open it before agreeing to serve Ranni the Witch at Ranni's Rise.
- Nokron, the upper Eternal City section of the Siofra River, becomes accessible after defeating Starscourge Radahn at the Wailing Dunes. The death of the Red Lion General releases certain stars from his gravitational grip, resuming fates held in stasis since the Starscourge Conflict. A falling star crashes to the earth in Limgrave, setting Ranni's Empyrean destiny back into motion. The starfall crater enables passage to the long-lost Eternal City.

rows.name: Fulgurbloom
rows.location:
- Fulgurbloom grows abundantly in spots where lightning strikes regularly. These spots can be found in every major area.
  - The earliest accessible spot of 14 Fulgurbloom is in Limgrave, on the hill just north of the Agheel Lake North site of grace.
  - In Weeping Peninsula a group of 8 can be found east from the MInor Erdtree in a small ravine accessible via Tombstones embedded in the side of the cliff.
  - In Altus Plateau, the largest collection, with 3 groups, can be found near the Rampartside Path site of grace, east of the Sainted Hero's Grave. Head west from the Grace for the first group of 10 and then head south for the second group of 8. Go northeast to get up on the hill just south of the Grace itself for the third group of 10. Be aware that Ancient Dragon Lansseax spawns very close to the route.
  - In Liurnia of the Lakes, directly northeast from the Island Testu's Rise is located on a group of 14 can be found.
  - In Caelid, more specifically Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, a group of 10 can be found along the way between the Minor Erdtree and the Farum Greatbridge.
  - At Castle Sol in Mountaintops of the Giants, the largest collection of two groups can be found. Just west of the Castle Sol Main Gate site of grace first a group of 13 and the of 15 is located.
  - In Consecrated Snowfield, east from the Ordina, Liturgical Town site of grace up the hill in the most north-eastern part of the area a group of 27 can be found around a rock pillar formation.
- Also dropped by certain lightning-infused enemies found in Altus Plateau and Leyndell, Royal Capital. Specifically Lightning Sheep (20%), and lightning pot-throwing Imps (10%) and Leyndell Soldiers (5%).

rows.location: - Obtained from a large pile of crystals in Raya Lucaria Academy, in central Liurnia of the Lakes. From the room west of the Debate Parlor, just before the fight with the Red Wolf of Radagon, look for an empty bookshelf on the north side of the room, which is an illusory wall. Dispell it, head into the next room, and climb a ladder. Proceed to the east side of this room, where a painting leans up against a railing, and jump over the railing to fall into another hollow wall. Drop through the hole at the end of this passageway to reach the room with the crystals.

- Obtained from a chalice in southeastern Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. The chalice resides inside a room locked by a semi-transparent fog wall, which can be unlocked by inserting one Stonesword Key into the adjacent imp statue.
  - From Elphael Inner Wall, head east to the courtyard once guarded by an Erdtree Avatar, and climb down the ladder at the southeast end of this area. Proceed southeast/clockwise through this lowermost level of Elphael to reach the fog wall.
  - Alternatively, and likely much easier, from Prayer Room proceed northeast to a buttress that can is within jump reach, use it to reach a connected pillar, drop to a ledge below that surrounds the pillar, and jump eastward from the pillar to the top of a rampart, patrolled by an Erdtree Avatar. Proceed to the southern end of this rampart, and jump over the inner railing to reach the fog wall.

rows.name: Memory Stone
rows.location:
A total of 8 Memory Stones can be acquired:

- **Purchased**
  - Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for 3,000 Runes.

- **Found in chests at the top of rises**
  - Oridys's Rise in the Weeping Peninsula (solve the three tortoise puzzle).
  - Testu's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes (solve the three tortoise puzzle).
  - Lenne's Rise in northeastern Caelid (access via Torrent's wind draft jump to the balcony).
  - Converted Tower in Liurnia (perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue; requires an Academy Glintstone Key given to Thops at the Church of Irith).
  - Seluvis's Rise in a chest at the top of the tower in the Three Sisters region.

- **Dropped by enemies**
  - Red Wolf of Radagon in Raya Lucaria Academy (Academy Glintstone Key required to enter).
  - Demi-Human Queen Maggie northeast of Hermit Village in Mt. Gelmir.
prereqs: - Converted Tower in Liurnia (perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue; requires an Academy Glintstone Key given to Thops at the Church of Irith).
- Red Wolf of Radagon in Raya Lucaria Academy (Academy Glintstone Key required to enter).

- Ten are given by Boc the Seamster after freeing him from his bush form just north of the Agheel Lake North site of grace.
- Radahn Soldiers and Exile Soldiers have a 15% drop rate.

rows.location:

rows.name: Revered Spirit Ash
rows.location:
A total of **25** Revered Spirit Ashes are found throughout the Realm of Shadow:

1. Gravesite Plain: On a small altar northeast of the  Gravesite Plain site of grace, past the white tree filled with hanging bodies.
1. Gravesite Plain: Found at an altar located to the east of the  Cliffroad Terminus site of grace, near a pond inhabited by turtles.
1. Abandoned Ailing Village: Revered Spirit Ash can be looted from an altar surrounded by Man-Flies.
1. Temple Town Ruins: South of the Temple Town Ruins, near the edge, you will see the altar.
1. Belurat, Tower Settlement: x2 Revered Spirit Ash can be found on the altar in a room infested by Spider-Scorpions.
1. Belurat, Tower Settlement: After defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, take the lift and proceed to open a large door; the altar is nearby.
1. Belurat, Tower Settlement: Climb up after defeating the two Gravebirds, and spot a Shadow Pothead that drops x1 Revered Spirit Ash and x1 Golden Horn Tender.
1. Belurat, Tower Settlement: After crossing the bridge with the Horned Warrior, turn left to find an altar with Revered Spirit Ash across from the central tree.
1. Bonny Village: Fall from the broken bridge and follow the path north past the Stray to find the statue with Revered Spirit Ash at the end of the road.
1. Moorth Ruins: East of the ruins, find a small shack containing the Revered Spirit Ash.
1. Village of Flies: Found on a body laid on a pedestal upon entering the Village of Flies.
1. Ancient Ruins of Rauh, West: Dropped by the Shadow Pothead in the area, along with x1 Silver Horn Tender, x1 Dewgem, and x1 Rauh Burrow.
1. Ancient Ruins of Rauh (West): Found on the statue in the center of the area. Beware of enemies nearby.
1. Enir-Ilim: Outside the  First Rise site of grace, take the stairs and cross the bridge to defeat a Large Inquisitor for a Revered Spirit Ash.
1. Enir-Ilim: x2 Revered Spirit Ash is located at the base of the statue in an indoor altar-like room with Man-Flies praying to an idol.
1. Enir-Ilim: Found in a small room on an altar; be cautious of Gravebird enemies in the area.
1. Ruins of Unte: Found on the altar near the stone wall southeast of the Ruins of Unte.
1. Ellac River Cave: Found on an altar near the  Ellac River Cave site of grace.
1. Midra's Manse: In the library, jump across bookshelves to reach a Large Inquisitor; defeat it for a Revered Spirit Ash.
1. Midra's Manse: Found on a body hanging from a chandelier near the  Midra's Manse site of grace.
1. Shadow Keep: Climb the statue’s feet and drop carefully onto the beast statue below to find the Revered Spirit Ash.
1. Shadow Keep: From the  Seventh Floor site of grace, jump onto the railings on the left to find this item on a hanging statue.
1. Ancient Ruins of Rauh (East): Dropped by a Shadow Pothead west of the  Viaduct Minor Tower site of grace.
rows.near: On a small altar northeast of the  Gravesite Plain
prereqs: Belurat, Tower Settlement: After defeating the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, take the lift and proceed to open a large door; the altar is nearby.
Belurat, Tower Settlement: Climb up after defeating the two Gravebirds, and spot a Shadow Pothead that drops x1 Revered Spirit Ash and x1 Golden Horn Tender.
Belurat, Tower Settlement: After crossing the bridge with the Horned Warrior, turn left to find an altar with Revered Spirit Ash across from the central tree.

rows.name: Ritual Pot
rows.location:
A total of **10** Ritual Pots can be obtained per character.

**Purchased**
- x1 from Pidia, Carian Servant in Caria Manor ( 1,500 runes).
- x1 from the Isolated Merchant (Dragonbarrow) in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow ( 3,000 runes).

**Looted**
- x1 in Laskyar Ruins (Liurnia of the Lakes), against the wall behind the northern arches.
- x1 in Academy of Raya Lucaria (Liurnia of the Lakes), in a chest guarded by three Glintstone Sorcerers and one Living Jar Warrior.
- x2 in Jarburg (Liurnia of the Lakes):
  - One on an overhang near the third house on the left.
  - One on top of an inert Living Jar Warrior just north of the Site of Grace.
- x2 in Auriza Side Tomb (Capital Outskirts):
  - One found after using a teleport chest and descending a ladder.
  - Another found by jumping from a window to a landing, guarded by a Living Jar Warrior.
- x1 in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds (Leyndell, Royal Capital), in a room filled with Living Jars before the elevator to the Forsaken Depths.
- x1 in Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs (Mountaintops of the Giants), inside a dead-end room with a Living Jar Warrior.

prereqs: - One found after using a teleport chest and descending a ladder.

rows.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
rows.location:
8% chance to be dropped by Putrid Crystalian Mages such as the one near the Elphael Inner Wall grace, located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

Another Putrid Crystalian Mage can be found by going down to the lower eastern rampart where a Rotten Avatar patrols and running north up the stairs and into the building. Since there are no spear-wielding Crystalians nearby and the Avatar does not respawn, it can be safer to grind for the staff from this one instead of the one in the inner wall. If you are simultaneously grinding for the Rotten Crystal Spear, however, the Inner Wall grace is better.

rows.name: Rune Arc
rows.location:
**Rune Arcs can be earned by completing online objectives**:
- All summoned Furled Fingers gain one Rune Arc upon when the area Boss is defeated, regardless of contribution.
- All present Invaders (Bloody Fingers and Recusants) gain one Rune Arc when the Host of Fingers dies, regardless of circumstances.
- All present Hunters gain one Rune Arc whenever an Invader dies, regardless of circumstances.

**Enemy Drops**:
- Rats and Giant Rats have a 1.00% chance of dropping x1 Rune Arc. Earthbore Cave and the  Beside the Rampart Gaol Site of Grace in Castle Morne, both in the Weeping Peninsula, are suitable farming locations.
- Frenzied Rats and Giant Frenzied Rats have a 0.50% chance to drop x1 Rune Arc.
- x1 is dropped by each of the following Volcano Manor assassination targets: Old Knight Istvan, Rileigh the Idle, and Great Horned Tragoth.

**Locations**:

- x1 is found on a corpse on a ledge in Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid.
- x1 is found found on a corpse near where the Golden Seed is in Siofra River. Follow the small path along the cliff's edges to the north to find a small cave with the corpse and a campfire.

**Purchase**:
- x5 are sold for  4,000 runes each by the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold.
- x3 are sold for  4,000 runes each by the Nomadic Merchant near the Bellum Church in Bellum Highway.
- x3 are sold for  4,000 runes each by the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack in the Capital Outskirts.
- x3 are sold for  8,000 runes each by the Hermit Merchant in eastern Mountaintops of the Giants.
- x3 are sold for  8,000 runes each by the Imprisoned Merchant in the Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum at the Mohgwyn Palace.
- x3 are sold for  8,000 runes each by Moore near the  Main Gate Cross in Gravesite Plain.
rows.near: Earthbore Cave and the  Beside the Rampart Gaol

rows.name: Sacramental Bud
rows.location:
Sacramental Buds can be found in the world. However, they do not respawn after dying or resting at a Site of Grace. They can only be obtained once per playthrough.

Altus Plateau
- x11 around the Writheblood Ruins: x9 inside and x2 southeast of the structure.
- x10 near St. Trina's Hideaway (the location of the Amber Starlight), north of the  Altus Highway Junction site of grace.
- x4 east of the entrance to Wyndham Catacombs, near the Wyndham Ruins.
- x1 far south of the  Bower of Bounty site of grace.

Caelid
- x15 around the Church of the Plague: x7 inside and x8 in the surrounding graveyard.
- x2 northwest of the  Southern Aeonia Swamp Bank site of grace, found on a corpse sitting in a chair.
- x1 next to a Giant Crow northeast of the  Smoldering Wall site of grace.

Leyndell Catacombs
- x2 beside the lever that opens the boss door.

Miquella's Haligtree
- x3 southeast of the  Haligtree Canopy site of grace.

Mohgwyn Palace
- x1 north of the  Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance site of grace.

Mt. Gelmir
- x6 around the Hermit Village: x2 southwest of the village and x4 on a nearby cliff to the northeast.
- x4 east of the Corpse-Stench Shack, growing near small corpse mounds.
- x4 on cliffs behind Fort Laiedd.
- x4 on a lower cliff beneath the Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir). Descend the long ladder east of the merchant, then proceed southwest.
- x4 north of Mt. Gelmir, west of the Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir), in an area guarded by bow-wielding Marionette Soldiers.
- x3 in an area of Mt. Gelmir, which is guarded by two foot soldiers.
- x3 at the base of a watchtower, west of the  First Mt. Gelmir Campsite.
- x3 close to the cliff near the Abductor Virgins, after the  Bridge of Iniquity, overlooking The Shaded Castle.
- x1 near Nomadic Merchant (Mt. Gelmir) but located on a separate cliff. From the  Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite, cross the rope bridge, descend the northeast ladder, then head south.
prereqs: However, they do not respawn after dying or resting at a Site of Grace.
- x3 close to the cliff near the Abductor Virgins, after the  Bridge of Iniquity, overlooking The Shaded Castle.

rows.name: Serpent-Hunter
rows.location:
- Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor)
**Loot: **Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard, just after the fog gate.

This item does not re-spawn when the player has one in either their inventory or chest, even in NG+. However it will re-spawn (and thus can be picked up again) from the same location should the player discard it. This is to make sure that the player always have the means of fighting Rykard with it.

Because of this safeguard it is still possible to obtain duplicates of this weapon:
- **Requirements:**
  - The player needs to not have a copy it in their inventory.
  - Rykard needs to still be alive.
  - The game needs to be in online-mode.
- 1) Stand outside Rykard's arena and attempt to connect to another player's world through any means necessary.
(Tarnished's Furled Finger, Duelist's Furled Finger, Bloody Finger, Recusant Finger, Festering Bloody Finger or Blue Cipher Ring)
- 2) When the game has successfully found a world it can try to connect to, enter Rykard's arena and pick up the Serpent-Hunter before the Loading Screen appears.
- 3) Leave the multiplayer session either by completing your objective or using the Finger Severer.
- 4) When you re-spawn back in your own world, do not fast travel or rest at the Sites of Grace, instead enter Rykard's arena again and you'll see the Serpent Hunter is still there, available to be picked up again for a second time.
(Traveling or resting at the site of grace will make the game check if the Serpent-Hunter is in your inventory before it decides if it'll spawn in a new one for you to pick up)
- It's possible to obtain even more copies of this weapon if the player simply loops back to step 1 after finishing step 3.
prereqs: **Loot: **Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard, just after the fog gate.
- It's possible to obtain even more copies of this weapon if the player simply loops back to step 1 after finishing step 3.

rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable melee weapons of any type with the Ash of War: Endure.
- Innate skill of the Blacksteel GreathammerShadow of the Erdtree, Bloodfiend's ArmShadow of the Erdtree, Caestus, Dragon Greatclaw, Duelist Greataxe, Giant-Crusher, Golem FistShadow of the Erdtree, Great Mace, Great Stars, Iron Ball (though it has Ash of War: Braggart's Roar equipped, overriding the skill), Pickaxe, Rotten Greataxe, Smithscript GreathammerShadow of the Erdtree, Spiked Caestus, and Star Fist,

rows.name: Skill: Glintstone Pebble
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable weapons of certain weapon types with the Ash of War: Glintstone Pebble.
- Default skill of the Lazuli Glintstone Sword.

rows.name: Skill: Gravitas
rows.location:
- Can be applied to infusable weapons with Ash of War: Gravitas.
- Found as the innate skill on the Meteoric Ore Blade.

rows.name: Skill: Ground Slam
rows.location: Can be granted to infusable melee weapons of any type with the Ash of War: Ground Slam.

rows.name: Skill: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker
rows.location: - Can be granted to infusible melee weapons of any type with Ash of War: Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker.

rows.name: Skill: Impaling Thrust
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable weapons capable of making thrusting attacks (except for Colossal Swords) with the Ash of War: Impaling Thrust.
  - Note that while two Fists has Impaling Thrust as their innate skill, they cannot equip the Ash of War and as such can only use the skill with a Standard affinity.
- Innate skill of many Thrusting Swords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Spears, and Fists.
  - Thrusting Swords: Antspur Rapier, Carian Sorcery Sword Shadow of the Erdtree, Cleanrot Knight's Sword, Estoc, Frozen Needle, Noble's Estoc, and Rapier.
  - Heavy Thrusting Swords: Godskin Stitcher, Great Épée, Queelign's Greatsword Shadow of the Erdtree, and Sword Lance Shadow of the Erdtree.
  - Spears Clayman's Harpoon, Cross-Naginata, Crystal Spear, Partisan, Short Spear, Smithscript Spear Shadow of the Erdtree, Spear, Spiked Spear, and Swift Spear Shadow of the Erdtree.
  - Fists (not compatible with the Ash of War): Katar and Pata Shadow of the Erdtree.

rows.name: Skill: Kick
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable melee weapons of any type with the Ash of War: Kick
- Innate skill of the Arbalest, Crepus's Black-Key Crossbow, Full Moon Crossbow, Hammer, Hand Ballista, Heavy Crossbow, Hoslow's Petal Whip, Jar Cannon, Light Crossbow, Mace, Monk's Flamemace, Morning Star, Pulley Crossbow, Rabbath's CannonShadow of the Erdtree, Short Sword, Soldier's Crossbow, Spread CrossbowShadow of the Erdtree, Stone Club, Thorned Whip, Urumi, Warpick, and Whip.
- This is also the innate skill of The Tarnished's own empty fists.

rows.name: Skill: Lion's Claw
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable swords, axes, and hammers (except for Daggers and any thrusting sword) with the Ash of War: Lion's Claw.
- Innate skill of the Claymore.

rows.name: Skill: Overhead Stance
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable Great Katanas with the Ash of War: Overhead Stance.
  - Since the only infusable Great Katana already has Overhead Stance as its innate skill, the purpose of this is purely to change its Affinity.
- Innate skill of the Great Katana.

rows.name: Skill: Parry
rows.location: - Parry is a skill that can be found as a default skill on many shields and some daggers. It can also be applied with Ash of War: Parry to compatible shields

rows.name: Skill: Piercing Fang
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable weapons capable of making thrusting attacks (except for Daggers, Throwing Blades, Colossal Swords, and Claws) with the Ash of War: Piercing Fang.
  - This Ash of War is by default equipped to the Nagakiba.

rows.name: Skill: Piercing Throw
rows.location:
- Can be granted to Throwing Blades Shadow of the Erdtree with the Ash of War: Piercing Throw Shadow of the Erdtree.
- Innate skill of the Smithscript Dagger Shadow of the Erdtree weapon.

rows.name: Skill: Quickstep
rows.location:
- Can be granted to any infusable melee weapon with the Ash of War: Quickstep.
- Innate skill of many Daggers and Claws, and a few Axes.
  - Daggers: Bloodstained Dagger, Celebrant's Sickle, Cinquedea, Crystal Knife, Dagger, Erdsteel Dagger, Fire Knight's Shortsword Shadow of the Erdtree, Great Knife, Ivory Sickle, Miséricorde, and Wakizashi.
  - Claws: Hookclaws, Raptor Talons, and Venomous Fang.
  - Axes: Forked Hatchet and Hand Axe.

rows.name: Skill: Raging Beast
rows.location: - Can be granted to Beast Claws Shadow of the Erdtree with the Ash of War: Raging Beast Shadow of the Erdtree.

rows.name: Skill: Raptor of the Mists
rows.location: - Can be granted to any infusable melee weapon or thrusting shield with the Ash of War: Raptor of the Mists.

rows.name: Skill: Repeating Thrust
rows.location:
- Can be any infusable weapon capable of thrusting (except for Colossal Swords) with the Ash of War: Repeating Thrust.
- Innate skill of the Rogier's Rapier and Scorpion's Stinger.

rows.name: Skill: Sacred Blade
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable weapons of certain weapon types with the Ash of War: Sacred Blade.
- Innate skill of the Inseparable Sword and Miquellan Knight's Sword.

rows.name: Skill: Savage Claws
rows.location:
- Can be granted to Beast Claws Shadow of the Erdtree with the Ash of War: Savage Claws Shadow of the Erdtree.
  - Since the only infusable Beast Claw already has Savage Claws as its innate skill, the purpose of this is purely to change its Affinity.
- Innate skill of the Beast Claw Shadow of the Erdtree weapon.

rows.name: Skill: Savage Lion's Claw
rows.location: - Can be granted to infusable swords, axes, and hammers (except for Daggers, Thrusting Swords, or Heavy Thrusting Swords) with the Ash of War: Savage Lion's Claw Shadow of the Erdtree.

rows.name: Skill: Scattershot Throw
rows.location:
- Can be granted to Throwing Blades Shadow of the Erdtree with the Ash of War: Scattershot Throw Shadow of the Erdtree.
- Innate skill of the Claws of Night Shadow of the Erdtree.

rows.name: Skill: Shield Crash
rows.location: - Can be granted to any infusable shield with the Ash of War: Shield Crash.

rows.name: Skill: Spinning Gravity Thrust
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable large and colossal swords with the Ash of War: Spinning Gravity Thrust Shadow of the Erdtree.
- Default skill on the Sword Lance Shadow of the Erdtree.

rows.name: Skill: Spinning Slash
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable swords, axes, and halberds (except for Colossal Swords) with the Ash of War: Spinning Slash.
- Innate skill of many Straight Swords, Curved Swords, Curved Greatswords, Twinblades, Halberds, and Reapers.
  - Straight Swords: Crystal Sword, Rotten Crystal Sword, and Warhawk's Talon.
  - Curved Swords: Bandit's Curved Sword, Beastman's Curved Sword, Falchion, Flowing Curved Sword, Grossmesser, Mantis Blade, Scavenger's Curved Sword, Scimitar, Shamshir, and Shotel.
  - Curved Greatswords: Beastman's Cleaver, Dismounter, Freyja's Greatsword Shadow of the Erdtree, Omen Cleaver, and Monk's Flameblade.
  - Twinblades: Black Steel Twinblade Shadow of the Erdtree, Gargoyle's Twinblade, Gargoyle's Black Blades, Twinblade, and Twinned Knight Swords.
  - Halberds: Gargoyle's Black Halberd, Gargoyle's Halberd, Glaive, Guardian's Swordspear, Nightrider Glaive, Pest's Glaive, Ripple Crescent Halberd, Vulgar Militia Saw, and Vulgar Militia Shotel.
  - Reapers: Grave Scythe and Scythe.

rows.name: Skill: Stamp (Sweep)
rows.location: - Can be granted to infusable swords, axes, and hammers (except for swords smaller than Greatswords) with the Ash of War: Stamp (Sweep).

rows.name: Skill: Stamp (Upward Cut)
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable swords, axes, and hammers (except for swords smaller than Greatswords) with the Ash of War: Stamp (Upward Cut).
- Innate skill of many Greatswords: the Banished Knight's Greatsword, Bastard Sword, Fire Knight's Greatsword Shadow of the Erdtree, Flamberge, Forked Greatsword, Greatsword, Iron Greatsword, Knight's Greatsword, Lizard Greatsword Shadow of the Erdtree, Lordsworn's Greatsword, Watchdog's Greatsword, and Zweihander.

rows.name: Skill: Swift Slash
rows.location:
- Can be granted to Backhand Blades Shadow of the Erdtree with the Ash of War: Swift Slash Shadow of the Erdtree.
  - <font color="red">WARNING:</font> Encountering Messmer the Impaler before getting this item prevents that character from acquiring it until their next Journey.

rows.name: Skill: Sword Dance
rows.location: Can be granted to Swords, Axes, and Polearms capable of making slashing attacks (except for Colossal Swords) with the Ash of War: Sword Dance.

rows.name: Skill: Troll's Roar
rows.location:
- Can granted to infusable large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers with the Ash of War: Troll's Roar.
- Default skill on the Troll's Golden Sword, Troll's Hammer and Troll Knight's Sword.

rows.name: Skill: Unsheathe
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable Katanas with the Ash of War: Unsheathe.
  - Since all infusable Katanas already have Unsheathe as their innate skill, the purpose of this is purely to change their Affinity.
- Innate skill of the Nagakiba and Uchigatana.

rows.name: Skill: War Cry
rows.location:
- Can be granted to any infusable melee weapon (except for small weapons, thrusting swords, and Whips) with the Ash of War: War Cry.
- Innate skill of several Axes (Highland Axe, Messmer Soldier's Axe Shadow of the Erdtree, and Warped Axe) and Greataxes (Crescent Moon Axe, Executioner's Greataxe, Gargoyle's Black Axe, Gargoyle's Great Axe, and Longhaft Axe).

rows.name: Skill: Wild Strikes
rows.location:
- Can be granted to infusable axes, hammers, curved swords, and greatswords (except for Colossal Swords and Colossal Weapons) with the Ash of War: Wild Strikes.
- Innate skill of the Battle Axe, Celebrant's Cleaver, Iron Cleaver, Jawbone Axe, Ripple Blade, Sacrificial Axe, and Smithscript AxeShadow of the Erdtree.

rows.name: Sleepbone Arrow
rows.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

rows.name: Sleepbone Arrow (Fletched)
rows.location:
This item can only be crafted with the [[Fevor's Cookbook 2|Fevor's Cookbook [2]]] and the following Crafting Materials:
- Thin Beast Bones x3
- Flight Pinion x1
- Trina's Lily x1

rows.name: Slumbering Egg
rows.location: - Dropped by Owls

rows.name: Small Golden Effigy
rows.location:
**Location**: Varies
- The Small Golden Effigy can be looted once from any Summoning Pool.

rows.name: Small Red Effigy
rows.location:
**Location**: Limgrave Colosseum
- The Small Red Effigy is found beside a Stranded Soul outside the Limgrave Colosseum.

rows.name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
rows.location:
**Dragon Communion:** Caelid / Jagged Peak
- Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of Temple Quarter in Liurnia.
prereqs: - Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of Temple Quarter in Liurnia.

rows.name: Smithing Stone 1
rows.location:
- Nomadic Merchant east of Saintsbridge (x3).
- Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold once given the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (x1).

rows.name: Smithing Stone 2
rows.location:
- Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace in the Liurnia of the Lakes region (x3).
- Sold by the Twin Maiden Husks in the Roundtable Hold once given the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (x1).
rows.near: Nomadic Merchant at the Liurnia Lake Shore

rows.name: Smithing Stone 3
rows.location:
- Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them
- Drops from miners, Radahn soldiers and Raya Lucaria soldiers
- Found in various locations around the world
prereqs: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them

rows.name: Smithing Stone 4
rows.location:
- Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them
- Scattered across the Lands Between
prereqs: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [2] to them

rows.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them
prereqs: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them

rows.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them.
prereqs: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [3] to them.

rows.name: Smithing Stone 7
rows.location: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them
prereqs: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them

prereqs: - Purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks after delivering the Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing [4] to them

rows.name: Smithing Talisman
rows.location:
The Smithing Talisman can be found in Ruined Forge Starfall Past:

- Obtained from a corpse in a room filled with Magma Tears on the upper-most level of the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

rows.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 1
rows.location: You can find it in the northeastern part of the lake in Liurnia of the Lakes, inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel, which is behind a Wandering Mausoleum(Wandering Mausoleums).

rows.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 2
rows.location: Found in Capital Outskirts, inside the Sealed Tunnel, which is at the southernmost part of the lake in the outskirts.

rows.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 3
rows.location: In the basement of the Zamor Ruins in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing 4
rows.location: Defeat the Godskin Duo in Crumbling Farum Azula.

rows.name: Smithscript Axe
rows.location: This weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge. Follow the path until you reach a crumbled floor. Jump over the gap and turn left to enter a room with a Golem Smith. The axe is at the far end of the room.

rows.name: Smithscript Cirque
rows.location: It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

rows.name: Smithscript Dagger
rows.location: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.

rows.name: Smithscript Greathammer
rows.location: The weapon can be found on a corpse at Taylew's Ruined Forge. After first jumping onto the pipe, simply cross over to the opposite side to find the hammer.
prereqs: After first jumping onto the pipe, simply cross over to the opposite side to find the hammer.

rows.name: Smithscript Shield
rows.location: Found on a corpse in Taylew's Ruined Forge. After reaching the top of the pipe at its original position, jump over to the path leading to the lever, but instead climb the rubble in the room past the hallway to reach the shield. It is guarded by a Golem Smith.
prereqs: After reaching the top of the pipe at its original position, jump over to the path leading to the lever, but instead climb the rubble in the room past the hallway to reach the shield.

rows.name: Smithscript Spear
rows.location:
**Location**: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
- On a corpse not far past the entrance. It is found to the right after crossing the bridge in the first room, near the ladder.
prereqs: It is found to the right after crossing the bridge in the first room, near the ladder.

rows.name: Smoldering Butterfly
rows.location:
Smoldering Butterflies are harvested in abundance throughout the Lands Between:
- They are almost always found at campfires and bonfires.
  - Near Bloody Finger Hunter Yura
  - Near Nomadic Merchants
  - On the burning pile of bodies in Castle Morne's courtyard
- They swarm wildfires and Fire Slugs.
  - North of Warmaster's Shack is a swarm around 2 Slugs.
  - Southwest of the  Eastern Tableland Site of Grace in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes is a Fire Monk camp that contains the gesture "Fire Spur Me". In the nearby area are 3 swarms of Butterflies.

Dropped by various enemies:
- Exile Soldiers
- Fire Slugs
- Guilty Sorcerer
- Enemies that carry Torchpoles or throw Fire Pots

They are a common minor loot item in Limgrave, Stormhill, and Stormveil Castle.

rows.name: Smoldering Shield
rows.location: Looted from a corpse in an low area filled with explosive Living Jars within Volcano Manor.

rows.name: Snow Witch Hat
rows.location:
**Location**: Renna's Rise
- The Snow Witch Hat is looted from a chest on the upper floor of Renna's Rise at Three Sisters in Liurnia of the Lakes. The tower becomes accessible during Ranni the Witch's questline.

rows.name: Snow Witch Robe
rows.location: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.
prereqs: Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

rows.name: Snow Witch Robe (Altered)
rows.location: Found unaltered inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline. Can be altered at a site of grace or by Boc.
prereqs: Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

rows.name: Snow Witch Skirt
rows.location: Found inside a chest inside Renna's Rise in Liurnia of the Lakes. Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.
prereqs: Can only be accessed after progressing through Ranni's Questline.

rows.name: Soap
rows.location:
- Craftable (requires Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17])
- Abandoned Merchant in the Siofra River region (x3)
prereqs: - Craftable (requires Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [17])

rows.name: Soft Cotton
rows.location:
- Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7], found at the end of a broken bridge towards Liurnia of the Lakes that is north of Stormhill Shack and to the east of Stormveil Castle.
- Found in Woodfolk Ruins, near a wall surrounded by Slugs.
- Found in a side tunnel at the end of Morne Tunnel, opposite the door to the boss.
- Found on the first part of the bridge to the Divine Tower of Limgrave, behind the Waygate to the second part of the bridge.
- 3 found under an archway in Nokron, Eternal City just before the building that holds the Fingerslayer Blade.
- Found south-southeast of the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins Site of Grace in Mountaintops of the Giants, just below the bridge south of Stargazer's Ruins.
rows.near: Found south-southeast of the Ancient Snow Valley Ruins
prereqs: - Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [7], found at the end of a broken bridge towards Liurnia of the Lakes that is north of Stormhill Shack and to the east of Stormveil Castle.

rows.name: Soiled Loincloth
rows.location:
**Location**: Varies
- The Soiled Loincloth is obtained by defeating or looting the Hornsent NPC at any location, such as Ancient Ruins of Rauh, Shadow Keep, and Enir-Ilim.

rows.name: Soldier's Crossbow
rows.location:
- 4% chance to be dropped by Foot Soldiers that wield it.
- 2% chance to be dropped by crossbow-wielding Exile Soldiers in Stormveil Castle.

rows.name: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes
rows.location: Dropped by the Grave Warden Duelist at the end of Auriza Side Tomb.

rows.name: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
rows.location:
There is a limited number of Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stones that can be acquired each playthrough. As of now, a total number of 8 have been discovered:

- Three in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
- One from Latenna upon completing her questline.
- One in the Mohgwyn Palace.
- One in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.
- One in the Crumbling Farum Azula.
- One dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater at the Consecrated Snowfield.
In Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree, slaying a Ghostflame Dragon will also provide a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone
prereqs: - One from Latenna upon completing her questline.

rows.name: Somber Smithing Stone 1
rows.location:
- 1x in Limgrave Tunnels. Before taking the third elevator fall down the edge on the left, and keep falling on the surfaces against the wall. There is a Golden Rune [1] on a platform with a dead body, the next one has a Somber Smithing Stone [1].
- x1 in Limgrave: Located on the field, on a dead body sitting on a chair.
- 1x dropped by an exploding Teardrop Scarab south-west of the Artist's Shack (Limgrave)
- x1 Church of Dragon Communion: At the lower cliff around the southern point dropped by a Teardrop Scarab.
- x1 dropped by a Teardrop Scarab on top of a ruined building in Limgrave.
- x1 dropped by The Lion Guardian in Stormveil Castle.
- x1 can be found in Morne Tunnel.
- x1 can be found in the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
- x1 Found behind Castle Morne at the south of Weeping Peninsula at the edge of the sea.
- Found on a corpse sitting in a chair under a massive rock outcropping guarded by a giant crab, northeast of Folly on the Lakes site of Grace, and south of Rose Church.

rows.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 1
rows.location: Defeat the Fallingstar Beast in Sellia Crystal Tunnel.

rows.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 2
rows.location: Defeat the Crystalian duo in the Altus Tunnel.

rows.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 3
rows.location: On a corpse just outside the First Church of Marika in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 4
rows.location: On a corpse by the Tempest-Facing Balcony site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.
rows.near: On a corpse by the Tempest-Facing Balcony

rows.name: Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5
rows.location: On a corpse in front of the altar at the bottom of the lift before the site of grace Beside the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.

rows.name: Sorcerer Leggings
rows.location: Chance to drop from Raya Lucarian Sorcerer enemies.

rows.name: Sorcerer Manchettes
rows.location: - The Sorcerer Manchettes have a 1.50% chance to drop from Glintstone Sorcerer enemies.

rows.name: Spear
rows.location:
- 2% chance to be dropped from the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle.
- A +7 version is dropped by Patches if he is killed, whether at his original spot in Murkwater Cave or at any point of his questline.

rows.name: Spear of the Impaler
rows.location: - Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Impaler with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
prereqs: - Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Impaler with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

rows.name: Spear Talisman
rows.location:
- Obtained from a chest in Lakeside Crystal Cave, in southern Liurnia of the Lakes.
  - The chest can be found in a demi-human campsite found by following the path in the cave without dropping down, past two braziers through a smaller cave in the back.

rows.name: Speckled Hardtear
rows.location: Dropped by the Wormface miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in central Altus Plateau, west of the Woodfolk Ruins.

rows.name: Spectral Steed Whistle
rows.location: Obtained from Melina after visiting three Sites of Grace and then resting. She will give the player the item after a cutscene and some dialogue.
prereqs: Obtained from Melina after visiting three Sites of Grace and then resting.
She will give the player the item after a cutscene and some dialogue.

rows.name: Spellblade's Gloves
rows.location: - The Spellblade's Gloves are dropped by Sorcerer Rogier.

rows.name: Spellblade's Pointed Hat
rows.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The Spellblade's Pointed Hat is dropped by Sorcerer Rogier at the end of his questline.

rows.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire
rows.location: Complete Rogier's questline.

rows.name: Spellblade's Traveling Attire (Altered)
rows.location: Complete Rogier's questline.

rows.name: Spellblade's Trousers
rows.location: Finish Sorcerer Rogier's questline.

rows.name: Spelldrake Talisman
rows.location: - Obtained by defeating the Runebear in the Earthbore Cave in northern Weeping Peninsula, southern Limgrave.

rows.name: Spelldrake Talisman +1
rows.location: - Obtained from a chest in Sellia, Town of Sorcery in northern Caelid. The chest can be found in a small alcove in the northwest section of town, which is locked behind a magical seal. This seal can be dispelled by lighting the flame in the southwest candle tower, within the town.

rows.name: Spelldrake Talisman +2
rows.location: - Obtained from a corpse in the Hidden Path to the Haligtree. From the large circular platform in the large central room, drop straight down from the broken railing to land on an invisible platform. Walk directly north, and then turn directly west, when aligned with an enemy that can be seen in the distance, standing on the invisible platform. At the end of the invisible platform, jump down to the ledge below, on the left, and through one of the open windows. Proceed south to the room with the boss door, and turn right to reach an elevator. The corpse lies in an alcove at the top of this elevator.

rows.name: Spelldrake Talisman +3
rows.location:
**Location**: Castle Ensis
- It can be looted from a corpse near the Castle Front site of Grace near Castle Ensis. From the Castle Front site of Grace, If you go directly north you can drop off of the cliffside and then follow the path east which will lead you to the storeroom where the talisman is located.
rows.near: It can be looted from a corpse near the Castle Front

rows.name: Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing
rows.location:
**Loot**: Rabbath's Rise
- The Spellmachinist's Bell Bearing is obtained in Rabbath's Rise on the Scadu Altus in the Realm of Shadow. It is reached by dropping down onto the rise from the Shaman Village in the Scaduview.

rows.name: Spellproof Dried Liver
rows.location:
- Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11] from the Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) who sits at the southern end of Lake of Liurnia's great lake, near the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace.
- Found in the room with guillotines in Black Knife Catacombs in Liurnia of the Lakes.
- Found on the same balcony that Pidia, Carian Servant resides on in Caria Manor in Liurnia of the Lakes.
- Found next to a large tombstone near a plank bridge during the outside section with Putrid Corpses at the Academy of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia of the Lakes.
prereqs: - Can be crafted after acquiring the Nomadic Warrior's Cookbook [11] from the Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore) who sits at the southern end of Lake of Liurnia's great lake, near the Liurnia Lake Shore Site of Grace.

rows.name: Spellproof Pickled Liver
rows.location: - Moore, just outside Belurat, Tower Settlement in the Graveside Plain (x2)

rows.name: Spider Scorpion Ashes
rows.location: Found in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

rows.name: Spiked Caestus
rows.location: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow for 4000 runes, or by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Isolated Merchant's Bell Bearing 3.
prereqs: Sold by the Isolated Merchant in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow for 4000 runes, or by the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them the Isolated Merchant's Bell Bearing 3.

rows.name: Spiked Club
rows.location: 2% chance to drop from Mighty Demi-Human enemies that wield it.

rows.name: Spiked Cracked Tear
rows.location: - Found at an altar near Mistwood's Minor Erdtree, along with Greenspill Crystal Tear

rows.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
rows.location: Looted from a corpse at the feet of a Guardian Golem in the chasm northwest of the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid.

rows.name: Spiked Spear
rows.location: 2% chance to be dropped by spear-wielding Marionette Soldiers.

rows.name: Spira
rows.location:
**Loot:** Enir-Ilim.
- From the First Rise Site of Grace, pass the fountain surrounded by Inquisitors and go up the stairs. Thereafter, find a way to walk on the branches to cross over to the platform with the single praying Inquisitor.

rows.name: Spiralhorn Shield
rows.location: Found on a corpse on a ledge to the northwest of the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace in the Uld Palace Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.

rows.name: Spiraltree Seal
rows.location: Reward for solving "The Sacred Tower" Painting puzzle. It can only be solved after using Messmer's Kindling on the Sealing Tree past Romina, Saint of the Bud.
prereqs: It can only be solved after using Messmer's Kindling on the Sealing Tree past Romina, Saint of the Bud.

rows.name: Spirit Calculus
rows.location: - Dropped by horned beasts in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.

rows.name: Spirit Calling Bell
rows.location:
**Location A**: Church of Elleh during the night
- After receiving the Spectral Steed Whistle from Melina, head to the Church of Elleh in Limgrave where Renna sits on a ruined wall during the night. Talk to her, and she'll give the Spirit Calling Bell, noting it was entrusted to her by Torrent's former master.
  - If it is not nighttime, pass time at a Site of Grace.

**Location B**: Roundtable Hold
- After meeting Ranni the Witch at Ranni's Rise, Renna will no longer appear at the Church of Elleh. The Spirit Calling Bell will instead be available for purchase from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for  1,000 runes.
prereqs: - After receiving the Spectral Steed Whistle from Melina, head to the Church of Elleh in Limgrave where Renna sits on a ruined wall during the night.
- After meeting Ranni the Witch at Ranni's Rise, Renna will no longer appear at the Church of Elleh.

rows.name: Spirit Glaive
rows.location: - In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plain and it will be on a grave.
prereqs: - In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plain and it will be on a grave.

rows.name: Spirit Jellyfish Ashes
rows.location:
Given by Roderika, Spirit Tuner at Stormhill Shack after talking to her.

If it hasn't been obtained by the time Roderika moves to Roundtable Hold it is possible to still obtain it by talking with her, though this option might not be offered if the game progresses to a certain unknown point after Leyndell, Royal Capital.
prereqs: Given by Roderika, Spirit Tuner at Stormhill Shack after talking to her.

If it hasn't been obtained by the time Roderika moves to Roundtable Hold it is possible to still obtain it by talking with her, though this option might not be offered if the game progresses to a certain unknown point after Leyndell, Royal Capital.

rows.name: Spirit Raisin
rows.location: Crafted with Forager Brood Cookbook (7).

rows.name: Spirit Sword
rows.location: This weapon can be found in Cerulean Coast, northeast from the  Cerulean Coast West site of grace, the entrance to a triangular ravine can be accessed. It's in the right corner in that lower area, near some demi-humans.

rows.name: Spiritflame Arrow
rows.location:
**Location:** Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
- x15 Spiritflame Arrows are found on a chair in a building on the ramparts northeast of the  Elphael Inner Wall site of grace.
**Random Drop:**
- 5.00% chance of dropping from Fallen Hawk Soldiers.

rows.name: Spiritgrave Stone
rows.location:
- Ancient Ruins of Rauh
- Fort of Reprimand

- Scorched Ruins
- Temple Town Ruins

rows.name: Spread Crossbow

rows.near: Found along the ravine south of the  Castle Front

rows.name: Spread Out
rows.location:
**Quest Item:** Liurnia of the Lakes

rows.name: Spritestone
rows.location:
- Spritestones are crafted with [[Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook 2|Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook [2]]] and the following Crafting Materials:

rows.name: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook 1
rows.location:
**Location**: Cerulean Coast
- The St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [1] is looted from a corpse near a large tree to the north of the  Cerulean Coast Cross Site of Grace on the Cerulean Coast of the Gravesite Plain.

rows.name: St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook 2
rows.location:
**Location**: Cerulean Coast

rows.location:

- Sold by the ??? for  ?? runes.

rows.name: Staff of Loss
rows.location: Found on a corpse on a balcony in Sellia, Town of Sorcery, located in Caelid.

rows.name: Staff of the Avatar
rows.location: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar south of the Great Waterfall Crest grace located in Deeproot Depths.

rows.name: Staff of the Great Beyond
rows.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers, dropped by Metyr, Mother of Fingers, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

rows.name: Staff of the Guilty
rows.location:
- 2.00% chance to be dropped by Guilty Sorcerers that wield this weapon, such as the ones near the Seethewater Terminus grace, located in Mt. Gelmir.
- ? % chance to drop from Guilty in Elden Ring Nightreign.

rows.name: Stalwart Horn Charm
rows.location: - Obtained from a corpse in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes. From Mausoleum Compound, head north up an incline, then left, and proceed southwest to a large tall rock formation. Walk counterclockwise around this formation to find a hole in the formation, forming an archway over a small ledge. Drop down from this ledge and head left to find the corpse, dangling over the edge of a cliff.

rows.name: Stalwart Horn Charm +1
rows.location: - Obtained from a corpse in southwestern Consecrated Snowfield, in western Mountaintops of the Giants. The corpse can be found laying over a log, between the two large dead trees, guarded by two Ancestral Followers.

rows.name: Stalwart Horn Charm +2
rows.location: - Stalwart Horn Charm +2 is found at the Bonny Gaol. Jump down into a hole and then climb a ladder to the east after passing rats. The talisman is located in a room with jar innards.
prereqs: Jump down into a hole and then climb a ladder to the east after passing rats.

rows.name: Stanching Boluses
rows.location: - Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave).

rows.name: Star Fist
rows.location: Can be looted from a corpse inside an arched alcove on the left side of the main entrance to the Royal Colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

rows.name: Star Shower
rows.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 10,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Conspectus Scroll.
- Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.
  - <font color="red">WARNING:</font> Should all three of Sellen, Miriel, and Seluvis die before giving any of them the scroll then this sorcery becomes unavailable for that character until a new Journey is started.
prereqs: - Sold for 10,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Conspectus Scroll.

- Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

rows.name: Star-Lined Sword
rows.location: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Marigga on the Cerulean Coast.

rows.name: Stargazer Heirloom
rows.location:
**Location**: Divine Tower of Liurnia
- The Stargazer Heirloom is looted from the charred body Lunar Princess Ranni, lying at the top of the Divine Tower of Liurnia in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

rows.name: Starlight
rows.location:
**Purchase:** Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at the Church of Irith.
- Should Thops die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Thops's Bell Bearing.
prereqs: - Should Thops die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Thops's Bell Bearing.

rows.name: Starlight Shards
rows.location:
- Typically found at the base of Stone Hemicycliums throughout the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow.
  - Astrolabes are commonly found near Rises or areas associated with Moon-worship.
- Starlight Shards are plentiful around and inside the Cathedral of Manus Celes on the Moonlight Altar.

rows.name: Stars of Ruin
rows.location:
**Quest Item:** Caelid
- Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker from Sellen in order to access him.
prereqs: Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker from Sellen in order to access him.

rows.name: Starscourge Greatsword
rows.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Starscourge, dropped by Starscourge Radahn, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).

rows.name: Starscourge Heirloom
rows.location:
**Location**: Fort Gael
- Obtained from a chest in Fort Gael, located in western Caelid. The chest is found beneath a canopy on the upper platform of the fort.

rows.name: Steel-Wire Torch
rows.location: Found at Castle Morne along the northern side of the castle, top level. It's on a body at the end of a narrow path, guarded by two misbegotten.

rows.name: Stimulating Boluses
rows.location: Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Western Limgrave).

rows.name: Stone Club
rows.location: 4% chance to drop from Battlemage enemies that wield it.

rows.name: Stone of Gurranq
rows.location:
**Quest Item:** Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
- Stone of Gurranq is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the sixth Deathroot. (However, only after Gurranq has been calmed down after he turns hostile on the player's return to him after consuming the fourth Deathroot.)
prereqs: - Stone of Gurranq is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the sixth Deathroot. (However, only after Gurranq has been calmed down after he turns hostile on the player's return to him after consuming the fourth Deathroot.)

rows.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
rows.location:
- Found at an altar in either Fog Rift Catacombs, Ruins of Unte, or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Since the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs is the most complicated to reach, it's recommended that the sword be taken there so that the later interactions with altars are less time-consuming.
  - <font color="red">**WARNING**</font>: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.
  - Fog Rift Catacombs: From the start, follow the path so that you pass the first and second falling-spikes roofs to the elevator. Continue to the third falling-spikes roof and get to the other side of the room (be wary of the pit in the second saferoom to the left). Use the raised platform at the end of the room to enter the hidden compartment in the falling roof, then ride it to a higher platform so you can stand on top of the falling roof. The altar is in the opposite right corner of the room, on the roof.
    - Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Ruins of Unte and the Sword of Light at Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
  - Ruins of Unte: Found to the right inside the courtyard, blocked by a Furnace Golem (a Hefty Fire Pot can get it going again to open the path).
    - Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Fog Rift Catacombs and the Sword of Light at Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
  - Ancient Ruins of Rauh: From Ancient Rauh Ruins, East Site of Grace, head across the bridge towards the west, then continue forward until a small body of water, and take a right. Take the Spirit Spring that is now straight ahead and jump forward (north-northeast on the map) to a ruin underneath the large cliff. Here is a body with the Greater Potentate's Cookbook 9 on a pile of rubble. Standing at the cookbook with the Spirit Spring directly behind you, turn to the right to see a tower and a "broken" bridge (actually just invisible) that can be crossed to reach the altar.
    - Picking the sword up here means it turns into the Sword of Darkness at Ruins of Unte and the Sword of Light at Fog Rift Catacombs.

rows.name: Stonebarb Cracked Tear
rows.location: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar miniboss at the Minor Erdtree in Caelid, on the cliffs north-east of the Smoldering Church.

rows.name: Stonesword Key
rows.location:
**Purchase**
- Twin Maiden Husks at Roundtable Hold (x3)
- Patches in Murkwater Cave (x1)
- Nomadic Merchant (Castle Morne Rampart) (x1)
- Isolated Merchant (Weeping Peninsula) (x3)
- Abandoned Merchant (Siofra River) (x3)

**Loot**
- Keepsakes choice at character creation.
- Limgrave: On a corpse in a tower at Dragon-Burnt Ruins.
- Weeping Peninsula: On a corpse at the Bridge of Sacrifice.
- Weeping Peninsula: On a chair on the northeastern cliffs, above the entrance to Impaler's Catacombs.
- Castle Morne: Found on a wooden ledge near the "Behind the Castle" .
- Siofra River: On a corpse near Hallowhorn Grounds, requiring platforming across ruins.
- Siofra River: On a ledge near a Golden Seed, reachable via support beams.

rows.name: Storehouse Cross Message
rows.location:
**Location**: Specimen Storehouse
- The **Storehouse Cross Message** is found near the Miquella's Cross in the Specimen Storehouse.

rows.name: Storeroom Key
rows.location:
**Location**: Belurat, Tower Settlement
- The Storeroom Key is looted from a corpse on the upper level of Belurat.

rows.name: Stormhawk Axe
rows.location:
- One inside Castle Sol, on a rooftop not far from where you find the Sorcerer Painting.

- One inside Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the court outside of the Fortified Manor where Abductor Virgin enemies are roaming.

- Two are dropped by Nepheli Loux if she is killed in the Village of the Albinaurics.

rows.name: Stormhawk Deenh
rows.location: Found in the Chapel of Anticipation. After returning to the area via the portal at The Four Belfries, go through the previously locked door near the main entrance, and follow the staircase into the upper level of the chapel to find the ashes.
prereqs: After returning to the area via the portal at The Four Belfries, go through the previously locked door near the main entrance, and follow the staircase into the upper level of the chapel to find the ashes.

rows.name: Stormwing Bone Arrow
rows.location: This item is not sold by merchants, dropped by enemies, or available as static loot.

rows.name: Strength!
rows.location:
- Limgrave, (Stranded Graveyard)
  - **Loot:** On a corpse hanging from a ledge past the Cave of Knowledge after defeating the Soldier of Godrick tutorial Boss.
prereqs: - **Loot:** On a corpse hanging from a ledge past the Cave of Knowledge after defeating the Soldier of Godrick tutorial Boss.

rows.name: Strength-knot Crystal Tear
rows.location: Found inside of a bowl at a cliff north-east of the Stormhill Shack, west of the Warmaster's Shack. There will be a Troll guarding it.

rows.name: String
rows.location:
- Four found in the ground level sewers of Leyndell, Royal Capital. From the Lower Capital Church Site of Grace, go down the ladder straight ahead and take the lower left route then turn right at the next turn. It is on the left side, guarded by 3 Giant Rats and 1 small Fingercreeper.
- Five found in Hermit Village, atop the roof of the southwesternmost house.
- Five found in Altus Plateau guarded by some Demi-Humans north of the Grand Lift of Dectus and northeast of Altus Plateau Site of Grace.
- Dropped by Demi-Humans of all varieties with a 5% droprate.
  - In Coastal Cave there are 7 Demi-Humans before the boss room and another 3 after it.
  - In Lakeside Crystal Cave there are 11 Demi-Humans on the upper level of the cave, including 1 Chief in the mini-cave at the back.
  - In Volcano Cave there are 16 Demi-Humans inside of the cave and another 6 just outside of it.
prereqs: - In Coastal Cave there are 7 Demi-Humans before the boss room and another 3 after it.

rows.name: String-Seller's Bell Bearing
rows.location:
**Loot**: Prospect Town
- The String-Seller's Bell Bearing is found in a hanging pot on a wall outside Prospect Town on the western Gravesite Plain. It must be shot down with a projectile.
prereqs: It must be shot down with a projectile.

rows.name: Strip of White Flesh
rows.location: - Land Octopus

rows.name: Sun Realm Shield
rows.location: 2% chance to be dropped from various Skeleton Knights who carry it.

rows.name: Sunwarmth Stone

rows.location:
**Purchase:** Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants
- Sold for  5,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Fire Monks' Prayerbook.
- Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

- Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then that instructor die before purchasing this Incantation, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

rows.name: Surging Frenzied Flame
rows.location: Crafted with [[Mad Craftsman's Cookbook 3|Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [3]]].

rows.name: Swarm of Flies
rows.location:
**Loot:** Mohgwyn Palace
- Located on a corpse at the end of one of the caves found in the northeastern quarter of the lake of blood.

rows.name: Swift Glintstone Shard
rows.location:
**Purchase:** Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold
- Sold for 600 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Academy Scroll.
- Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.
