prereqs: - Sold for 600 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Academy Scroll.

- Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die before purchasing this Sorcery, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them the respective tutor's Bell Bearing.

rows.name: Swift Spear
rows.location:
**Location**: Gravesite Plain
- The weapon can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the upper road going southeast from the  Castle Front site of grace outside Castle Ensis.

rows.name: Swollen Grape
rows.location: - Found as loot and dropped by Aging Untouchables.

rows.name: Sword Lance
rows.location: Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
prereqs: Can be obtained after trading Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider with Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.

rows.name: Sword of Darkness
rows.location:
- Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Light to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte.
  - <font color="red">**WARNING**</font>: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.
  - See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations.
  - If the Stone-Sheathed Sword was taken from Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh, the altar at Ruins of Unte should be used. If it was taken from Ruins of Unte, the altar at Fog Rift Catacombs should be used.

rows.name: Sword of Light
rows.location:
- Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Darkness to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
  - <font color="red">**WARNING**</font>: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.
  - See the page for the Stone-Sheathed Sword for all 3 altar locations.
  - If the Stone-Sheathed Sword was taken from Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte, the altar at Ancient Ruins of Rauh should be used. If it was taken from the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, the altar at Fog Rift Catacombs should be used.

rows.name: Sword of Milos
rows.location:
Can be acquired in two different, mutually exclusive ways:
- Dropped by the Dung Eater when he invades in the southern end of the moat in Capital Outskirts, at the spot where Blackguard Big Boggart normally sits.
- Alternatively also dropped by the Dung Eater if he is killed in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds before the invasion, along with the Omen Set.

rows.name: Sword of Night
rows.location: - Complete Jolán, Swordhand of Night's questline.

rows.name: Sword of Night and Flame
rows.location:
In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear.

More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path splits in two. Follow the path as it turn to the right and look to the left when halfway across the last walkway. Search for a nearby roof to jump onto and then walk forward to find another roof further down. In one of the corners should be a ladder leading down into the inside of a tower with a chest containing the sword as well as a door leading outside.

rows.name: Sword of St. Trina
rows.location: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.

rows.name: Swordhand of Night Jolán
rows.location: Obtained after completing Count Ymir's questline and boss fight and giving Jolán the Iris of Grace.
prereqs: Obtained after completing Count Ymir's questline and boss fight and giving Jolán the Iris of Grace.

rows.name: Tailoring Tools
rows.location:
**Location**: Coastal Cave
- The Tailoring Tools are obtained alongside the Sewing Needle upon defeating the Demi-Human Chiefs at Coastal Cave.

rows.name: Taker's Cameo
rows.location: - Obtained from Tanith in Volcano Manor in central Mt. Gelmir after completing the third assassination quest, by killing Juno Hoslow in northern Mountaintops of the Giants, near the Shack of the Lofty.
prereqs: Gelmir after completing the third assassination quest, by killing Juno Hoslow in northern Mountaintops of the Giants, near the Shack of the Lofty.

rows.name: Talisman of All Crucibles
rows.location:
Found in a treasure chest in the western Ancient Ruins.

If you have the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway Site of Grace unlocked, start there and take the nearby lift down; then, enter the square passage towards the south by using Torrent's double jump, using the adjacent pile of rocks to gain enough height to do so. Through the passage is a room containing the treasure chest.

If you only have the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West grace unlocked, start there and enter the tunnel to the southwest. Follow the tunnel's left wall until you reach a lift; take it up and then round the corner to the left. Below the cliff is a walkable lattice structure; jump down onto it and follow the path. At the intersection, enter the room to your left, which contains the aforementioned square passage and the elevator to the Grand Stairway grace.

rows.name: Talisman of Lord's Bestowal
rows.location:
**Location**: Shadow Keep
- The Talisman of Lord's Bestowal is obtained in the Shadow Keep, beside the large golden tree.

rows.name: Talisman of the Dread
rows.location: - Found inside the Elder's Hovel in Gravesite Plain.

rows.name: Talisman Pouch
rows.location:
**Location A**: Defeat Margit, the Fell Omen
- Rewarded automatically upon his defeat at the entrance of Stormveil Castle.

**Location B**: Speak to Finger Reader Enia
- After defeating two or more Shardbearers, speak with Enia at the Roundtable Hold to receive the second pouch.

**Location C**: Defeat Godfrey, First Elden Lord (golden shade)
- Drops upon defeating him in Leyndell, Royal Capital.
prereqs: - After defeating two or more Shardbearers, speak with Enia at the Roundtable Hold to receive the second pouch.

rows.name: Tarnished Golden Sunflower
rows.location:
- Most commonly found around Minor Erdtrees in Limgrave, Weeping Peninsula, Liurnia of the Lakes (northeast), and Caelid.
  - The Minor Erdtree (Limgrave), located in Mistwood, has many of these flowers around it and is not guarded by an Erdtree Avatar or Guardians.
  - Another location is in the Weeping Peninsula, found in an open field beneath a broken wall north of the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace or southwest of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace. Be cautious of a Deathbird that spawns at night here, but the Holy Water Pot crafted from this material can aid in defeating it.
  - Jarburg holds many of these, along with various other plants.
- Guardians have a 4% chance to drop this item.

rows.name: The Ring
rows.location:
Players who pre-ordered Elden Ring and successfully registered the pre-order bonus code will receive this gesture automatically at the very start of every playthrough.

Players who did not pre-order the game can still receive the gesture after successfully defeating a boss with another player who does have the pre-order bonus.
prereqs: Players who did not pre-order the game can still receive the gesture after successfully defeating a boss with another player who does have the pre-order bonus.

rows.name: The Stormhawk King

- Use an Imbued Sword Key to activate the Sending Gate at The Four Belfries labeled "Precipice of Anticipation."
- Return to the Chapel of Anticipation and defeat the Grafted Scion.
- Enter the previously locked side door and ascend to the rooftop to find The Stormhawk King.

  - Give the Black Syrup to Thiollier.
  - Ask Thiollier about the Syrup and tell him "I'm weary if Life".
  - You will receive the Concoction and Thiollier will now sell more of it for 30,000 runes each.

rows.location:
- The Warrior Gauntlets are the starting armwear of the Warrior Origin.
- The Warrior Gauntlets can be purchased from the Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria) for  1,000 runes.

rows.name: Warrior Greaves
rows.location:
Starting gear for the Warrior class.

Purchased from Isolated Merchant (Academy of Raya Lucaria).

rows.name: Warrior Jar Shard
rows.location: - Obtained by killing Iron Fist Alexander, before completing his questline.

rows.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
rows.location:
Dropped from the Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemies that wield it.

The simplest grinding spot is in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. A Watchdog shade is found in the first big open room with a circle of Rosus's light. It staggers when led into the light, making for easy damage at the start of combat. If it is approached from behind by dropping down from the high windows, the two imp shades in the room can be defeated before approaching the Watchdog.

rows.name: Watchdog's Staff
rows.location: Found on a corpse behind an illusory wall under a stairwell, inside Road's End Catacombs, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

rows.name: Watchful Spirit
rows.location:
**Loot:** Belurat, Tower Settlement
- Gained by speaking to the Hornsent Grandam twice while wearing the Divine Beast Head.
  - She can be found by exiting the room with the Small Private Altar Site of Grace and taking a left to walk across a thin bridge to find a locked door that requires the Storeroom Key on your left. She is on the right side of that room.
  - Must be done before defeating Messmer the Impaler.
prereqs: - She can be found by exiting the room with the Small Private Altar Site of Grace and taking a left to walk across a thin bridge to find a locked door that requires the Storeroom Key on your left.
- Must be done before defeating Messmer the Impaler.

rows.name: Wave
rows.location: Available from the start of the game.

rows.name: Weathered Dagger
rows.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- Speak with Fia multiple times in secret to receive the Weathered Dagger.

rows.name: Weathered Map
rows.location:
**Location**: Caria Manor
- The **Weathered Map** can be purchased from Pidia, Carian Servant at Caria Manor for  600.
- Alternatively, it may be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Pidia's Bell Bearing.
prereqs: - Alternatively, it may be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks after giving them Pidia's Bell Bearing.

rows.name: Weathered Straight Sword
rows.location:
Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate.
- An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace).
- A more complicated but also more efficient farming spot is heading southwest from the Secluded Chamber Site of Grace and, once up a small pile of rocks, turn around to the right and use a wooden platform to jump to a thin stone ledge. Jump to a dark room to the right and proceed along the path to a second dark room, full of Commoners.

rows.name: Well Depths Key
rows.location:
**Location**: Belurat, Tower Settlement
- The Well Depths Key is looted from a corpse in the upper section of Belurat.

rows.name: What Do You Want?
rows.location:
**Quest Item:** Roundtable Hold
- Given to the player after attempting to speak with Ensha of the Royal Remains next to Gideon's study in the Roundtable Hold.
prereqs: - Given to the player after attempting to speak with Ensha of the Royal Remains next to Gideon's study in the Roundtable Hold.

rows.name: Whetstone Knife
rows.location:
**Location**: Gatefront Ruins, Limgrave
- Found in a chest inside the underground cellar at Gatefront Ruins, alongside the Ash of War: Storm Stomp.

rows.name: Whip
rows.location: Castle Morne: Inside the second prison cell area reached by dropping down onto a couple of beams. The room is filled with rats and a misbegotten.

rows.name: Whirl, O Flame!
rows.location:
**Loot:** Caelid
- Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in northern Caelid, between the Caelem Ruins and the Rotview Balcony sites of grace. The scarab is located right behind the black carriage containing the Greatsword.

rows.name: White Cipher Ring
rows.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The White Cipher Ring can be purchased from the Twin Maiden Husks at the Roundtable Hold for  1,000 runes.

rows.name: White Mask
rows.location:
**Location**: Mohgwyn Palace
- White Mask is dropped by one of the three Nameless White Mask invaders in Mohgwyn Palace, northwest of the  Palace Approach Ledge-Road Site of Grace, in the blood-filled lake. The invader that drops it is found adjacent to the Giant Crow near the lake exit from the tunnel.

rows.name: White Reed Armor
rows.location: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: White Reed Gauntlets
rows.location:
**Location**: Spiritcaller Cave
- The White Reed Gauntlets are found on a corpse in the Spiritcaller Cave in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: White Reed Greaves
rows.location: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: Whiteflesh Mushroom
rows.location:
- Whiteflesh Mushrooms are commonly harvested throughout the Gravesite Plain.
- Can be dropped by Shadow Nobles.

rows.name: Windy Crystal Tear
rows.location: Looted from a bowl in southern Caelid, south of the highway.

rows.name: Wing of Astel
rows.location:
Found inside a chest in Uhl Palace Ruins above a Withered Astel, located in Ainsel River and only reachable from Ainsel River Main.

More specifically, from  Ainsel River Main site of grace and head down the tunnel. Take the left split in the road, guarded by a Hardhead Giant Ant, and follow the cliffside path to a stone structure with the chest.

rows.name: Winged Crystal Tear
rows.location:
Found at a sap collection basin on top of some cliffs west of Capital Outskirts' Minor Erdtree and east of Hermit Merchant's Shack.
It is guarded by a group of Skeletal Slugs along with an additional Deathbird at night.

rows.name: Winged Greathorn
rows.location:
Trade the Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor, obtained by defeating the Regal Ancestor Spirit, with Finger Reader Enia.

Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums to duplicate it (only one can be obtained per playthrough using either method).

rows.name: Winged Misbegotten Ashes
rows.location: Unsightly Catacombs, on the bottom level of a hall with lots of dead Misbegotten on the ground around it.

rows.name: Winged Scythe
rows.location:
**Location**: Tombsward Ruins
- The Winged Scythe is found in a treasure chest in the underground cellar at the Tombsward Ruins, located on the western Weeping Peninsula.

rows.name: Winged Serpent Helm
rows.location:
**Location**: Shadow Keep
- The Winged Serpent Helm is obtained by defeating Fire Knight Kood at the Shadow Keep, who also drops Ash of War: Flame Spear. He guards the path to Messmer the Impaler and is reached from the Specimen Storehouse by climbing specimens after using the lever to move them. Head outside, turn right, and head up the stairs. Then turn left and cross the bridge.
prereqs: He guards the path to Messmer the Impaler and is reached from the Specimen Storehouse by climbing specimens after using the lever to move them.

rows.name: Winged Sword Insignia
rows.location: - Obtained from Stillwater Cave in southern Liurnia of the Lakes, by defeating the Cleanrot Knight boss.

rows.name: Winter-Lantern Fly
rows.location: - Found in the Abyssal Woods.

rows.name: Wise Man's Mask
rows.location:
**Location**: Varies
- The Wise Man's Mask is looted from Sir Ansbach after completing his quest Enir-Ilim. It may also be obtained by helping Needle Knight Leda defeat Sir Ansbach at the Specimen Storehouse.
prereqs: - The Wise Man's Mask is looted from Sir Ansbach after completing his quest Enir-Ilim.

rows.name: Witch's Glintstone Crown
rows.location:
**Location**: Raya Lucaria Grand Library
- The Witch's Glintstone Crown is obtained upon completing Sorceress Sellen's questline at the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
  - If the player sided with Sorceress Sellen, then the Witch's Glintstone Crown will be on the floor beside her following her transformation.
  - If the player sided with Witch-Hunter Jerren, then Sorceress Sellen drops the crown upon defeat.
prereqs: - The Witch's Glintstone Crown is obtained upon completing Sorceress Sellen's questline at the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

rows.name: Wolf Crest Shield
rows.location:
**Loot**: Castle Ensis, Realm of Shadow
- The Wolf Crest Shield is found on a corpse in Castle Ensis down the stairs to the right of the chapel entrance guarded by Moonrithyll.

rows.name: Wooden Greatshield
rows.location: In the guarded courtyard in Stormveil Castle, it's located in the guardhouse to the right if entering the area from the main gates, opposite side from the room with the "Prophecy" Painting.

rows.name: Wrath from Afar
rows.location:
**Loot:** Shadow Keep
- Found at the Specimen Storehouse in the Storehouse Loft on one of the giant cogs.

rows.name: Wrath of Gold
rows.location:
**Loot:** Altus Plateau
- Found in a treasure chest in the cellar of Woodfolk Ruins. The cellar is located in a cluster of ruins in the southeasternmost quarter of the forest.

rows.name: Yellow Fulgurbloom
rows.location:
- Yellow Fulgurbloom is found in the catacombs in the Realm of Shadow: Fog Rift Catacombs, Scorpion River Catacombs, and Darklight Catacombs.
- Found in the lightning-struck forest downstream of the Ellac River.

rows.name: Ymir's Bell Bearing
rows.location:
**Defeat**: Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers
- Ymir's Bell Bearing is obtained by defeating Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers, at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr in the Scadu Altus region of the Realm of Shadow. This battle takes place at the end of his questline.

rows.name: Young Lion's Armor
rows.location:
**Location**:
-

rows.name: Young Lion's Helm
rows.location:
**Location**: Roundtable Hold
- The Young Lion's Helm can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Radahn, Consort of Miquella.
prereqs: - The Young Lion's Helm can be purchased from Finger Reader Enia after defeating Radahn, Consort of Miquella.

rows.name: Zamor Armor
rows.location:
**Location**: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
- Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, located on the Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: Zamor Bracelets
rows.location:
**Location**: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
- The Zamor Bracelets is received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, located on the Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: Zamor Curved Sword
rows.location: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, defeat the miniboss of the dungeon: Ancient Hero of Zamor.

rows.name: Zamor Ice Storm
rows.location:
**Loot:** Mountaintops of the Giants
- Acquired from a corpse lying next to a wall in the southernmost quarters of the Zamor Ruins.

rows.name: Zamor Legwraps
rows.location: Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, located in Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: Zamor Mask
rows.location:
**Location**: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
- The Zamor Mask is received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, located in Mountaintops of the Giants.

rows.name: Zorayas's Letter
rows.location:
**Location**: Volcano Manor
- **Zorayas's Letter** is found at Zorayas the Scout's final location at Volcano Manor after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and choosing neither to kill her nor give her the Tonic of Forgetfulness.
prereqs: - **Zorayas's Letter** is found at Zorayas the Scout's final location at Volcano Manor after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy and choosing neither to kill her nor give her the Tonic of Forgetfulness.

rows.name: Zweihander
rows.location: - Isolated Merchant in his shack in the Weeping Peninsula region (x1)
